# PR Checklist

- [ ] I ran the app locally without any errors (`uv run dev`)
- [ ] I manually tested the affected endpoints (using Postman)
- [ ] I updated the `postman.json` file
- [ ] I updated any relevant Pydantic schemas
- [ ] I did not accidentally commit irrelevant files
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, `.env`, or `.env.local`
- [ ] If I added a required setting, I documented it as a placeholder in `.env.example` and `docs/configuration.md`
- [ ] I checked that my code follows the style guidelines (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] I added docstrings where appropriate
- [ ] I updated `API.md` with a description of my endpoints and schemas
- [ ] I updated the card in Jira
  
[If you are unsure about anything, write a comment or question here!]
